title: Review of Aurora before the incident: raw originals had no copy outside Volume 1

case.facts: Review of project Aurora before the incident. raw/DSC_0101, raw/DSC_0142 and raw/DSC_0150 are ordinary assets with no recorded copy outside Volume 1. exports/previews/cover-preview.jpg has no copy and the user declared that folder regenerable.
case.expected_text: The review reports the three raw originals as at risk under a Volume 1 failure and does not report the preview as at risk.
